body: The `embed_options_menu` is hidden when the feature `FEATURE_WINDOW_EMBEDDING` is not available for the current ``DisplayServer`. It's hidden in the `_notification` method for the `NOTIFICATION_READY`. From what I understand the new option is useful even the embedding is not available. Maybe the menu should not be hidden but only the options for the embedding when the embedding is not available now that there's an option available for all platform.
